profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker DT and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with SEC filing identifier CIK 0001773383. Its website describes it as offering observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, aimed at helping customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes. The company describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader and frames its offering as observability built for the age of AI.

The site presents AI as central to its positioning. It quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer quote carried on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The company's litigation record shows 191 cases in Massachusetts. No individual cases, products, or MCP servers are listed for it.
